title: Casper and the Will
author: Mirabel Dunmore
blurb: Lior Galloway, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
